label: CSRD Data Collection Orchestrator
description: Structures CSRD (Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive) data collection across departments. Maps ESRS requirements to data sources, owners, and collection methods.

claudeKnowledge.description: ESRS standards, EFRAG guidance, CSRD Directive 2022/2464, EFRAG Q&A

guidedInputs.label: Material ESRS topics (from your Double Materiality Assessment)
guidedInputs.placeholder:
List the ESRS topics that your Double Materiality Assessment identified as material. If not yet completed, describe your business and I will suggest likely material topics.

Example: Climate change (E1), Own workforce (S1), Business conduct (G1)

guidedInputs.label: Current data collection state
guidedInputs.placeholder: What sustainability data do you already collect? What systems store it? Who is currently responsible? Are you already reporting under GRI, TCFD, or other frameworks?

guidedInputs.label: Key departments / functions
guidedInputs.placeholder: List the main departments that will need to provide data (e.g., Finance, HR, Facilities/Real Estate, Procurement, IT, Operations, Risk, Investor Relations)

guidedInputs.label: Specific challenge or focus area
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Scope 3 data collection is our biggest challenge, we don't know how to map ESRS requirements to our existing systems, we need to set up a data governance process
